attributes.title: Level 4

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ What sprite should be selected in the (tilemap location of (sprite)) of the [set tile at location] block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which sprite should the crate tile be set under? 


Solution: 

The sprite in the (tilemap location of (sprite)) block should be changed from (mySprite) to (playerSprite).
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Fix the bugs in the code so that when the B button is pressed, a crate tile is set underneath the Player sprite.

subgroups.title: Debugging Tilemap Location Blocks

})

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that a tile and wall are set below the Player sprite when the A button is pressed.

validationItems.text: Sprite in (tilemap location of (sprite)) blocks changed to playerSprite.
validationItems.failureText: Check the sprite selected in the (tilemap location of (sprite)) block.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ What direction should be selected in the (tilemap location [left] of (tilemap location of (playerSprite)) block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ In which direction from the Player sprite do the crate tiles appear?

❓ In which direction from the Player sprite should the walls be set?


Solution: 

The direction in the (tilemap location [left] of (tilemap location of (playerSprite)) block should be changed from [left] to [bottom].
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the Player sprite is unable to jump on top of the created crate tiles. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that when the B button is pressed, a wall is set in the same location as the crate tile.

steps.hints: ❓ What block should be used so that a crate tile is set at the same location as the wall?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which block determines where the walls will be set? 

❓ How can that be used to determine where the crate tile will be set?


Solution: 

The (tilemap location of (playerSprite)) block should replace (location) in the [set tile at location] block.
steps.instructions:
When you press the B button, there’s an error in the code!


Fix the bugs in the code so that when the B button is pressed, a crate wall tile appears underneath the Player sprite.

controller.B.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    let location: tiles.Location = null
    tiles.setTileAt(location.getNeighboringLocation(CollisionDirection.Bottom), assets.tile`myTile0`)

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of Green Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about tilemap location and extension blocks. These blocks can connect different tilemaps more easily and cause different things to happen based on a specific location or tile. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: Charting a Course
badges.description: Use the tilemap extension in MakeCode to extend the possibilities in a tilemap project.

badges.title: Neighbors
badges.description: Find the tilemap location next to a specific tile or sprite.

badges.title: GPS
badges.description: Find the exact tile location of a sprite on a tilemap.

badges.title: Ducks in a Row (Or Column)
badges.description: Find the row or column value of a specific location on a tilemap.

badges.title: Atlas
badges.description: Link two different tilemaps together in a project.

badges.title: Area Rug
badges.description: Temporarily cover all tiles of a specific kind on a tilemap.
